programs.title: Man v Food 2
programs.desc: Adam sets off on a journey across the United States to take part in subsequent rounds of timed eating competitions.Adam will take on Badass Burrito in Las Vegas and a 106-centimetre pizza in San Antonio.

programs.title: Unobvious places
programs.desc: Katarzyna Jaroszyńska visits unusual houses, located in charming natural surroundings.The host will watch, among others:Dutch houses, barges, trailers, and houses made of containers.

programs.title: Unobvious places
programs.desc: Katarzyna Jaroszyńska visits people who have converted buildings previously used for service or industrial purposes into houses.Marcelina and Dawid looked for their place on earth for a long time.Finally, they decided to renovate the old mushroom farm that belonged to the family.Converting a commercial building into a residential building presented many challenges.Krzysztof decided to adapt the former printing plant to his needs.He now lives in a surprising interior, from the outside resembling a cube glued to a block of flats in Wrocław.Mateusz and his relatives accidentally came across a mill during a trip to Siedlce.The view from the third floor of the building overlooking the river helped them decide to purchase this unusual building.

programs.title: Unobvious places
programs.desc: Katarzyna Jaroszyńska this time visits people whose households should be called crazy.Agnieszka is the owner of Kozi Stok, a farm located near Wieliczka, where she breeds Carpathian goats.Out of love for acrobatics and her son, the woman built a place suspended in the treetops.Jacek and his family lived in a 227-year-old wooden windmill standing in a landscape park.The renovation of this historic building became the man's true passion.Malwina inherited her love for water from her father, a sailor.The man managed to fulfill his dream of building a house on the water.It stands in Warsaw's Czerniakowski Port.

programs.title: Unobvious places
programs.desc: Katarzyna Jaroszyńska visits people who have turned ordinary allotment gardens into real gems.Alina built an arched house on her piece of land, which measures less than 14 square meters.The building is surrounded by a vegetable garden, flowerbeds and a small orchard.Aneta and her husband's plot, located near Olsztyn, is surrounded by greenery.The couple made many of its elements themselves.After Patrycja bought her own piece of land, her father and the woman's partner built a house there together.In this way, they fulfilled Patrycja's dream of having morning coffee on her own terrace.

programs.title: Manhunt with Joel Lambert
programs.desc: Former Navy SEAL, Joel Lambert, faces an elite reconnaissance unit of the American army.Within two days, he must cover a specific route so as not to get caught.During this unusual mission, he can use the items he has in his backpack and what he finds along the way.Thanks to modern filming techniques, viewers follow the manhunt, both from the point of view of the hunted and the commandos tracking him.The program was shot in the United States, Poland, South Africa, the Philippines, Panama and South Korea.

programs.title: Mega Shippers
programs.desc: An army of specialists delivers special cargo all over the world on time.Some of them are huge, others - very valuable.

programs.title: Asian Times
programs.desc: Julian Hanton visits Asia.It checks what changes are taking place on the continent, where economic recovery goes hand in hand with population growth.The leader begins his journey in Hong Kong, where he inadvertently agrees to take a punch from Bruce Lee.This experience will be remembered for a long time.In Thailand, he makes friends with investigative journalists, becomes a secret agent and monitors local gambling.In the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia and China, he carefully observes people and their behavior.He discovers that all corners of the world are an inexhaustible source of knowledge.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: Martyna goes to Romania, where she visits Iana Matei, founder of the Reaching Out organization, which helps victims of human trafficking.This country is considered the European center of slavery.Iana Matei has been fighting traffickers for 18 years.He does everything he can to save the children they abuse.By stealing victims from the hands of criminals, he tries to give them back their childhood and give them a home.Her pupils call her "Mom".Iana currently cares for 15 girls.The youngest of them was sold when she was 9 years old, while another was exchanged for 4 cigarettes.During Iana's 18 years of work, she saved over 500 girls.Her biggest dream is to stop human trafficking.
